title: Fried rice
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add garlic and the white part of the green onion, stir-fry 20 seconds until fragrant.
Push aromatics aside, pour in eggs, scramble until just set.
Add day-old rice, breaking up clumps, toss to coat in oil for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in peas and carrots, then add soy sauce around the edge of the pan.
Toss everything together, garnish with the green tops of the green onion, serve hot.

notes.text: Rice stuck to the pan a bit — use a tablespoon more oil next time and let the wok get properly hot before adding it.

title: Weeknight ramen
steps: Bring stock to a simmer with soy sauce.
Cook noodles separately according to package instructions.
Divide noodles into bowls, ladle broth over top.
Finish with sesame oil, halved soft-boiled eggs, and green onion.

title: Sourdough focaccia
steps: Mix flour, starter, and water, rest 30 minutes.
Add salt, work into the dough, cover and bulk ferment overnight.
Press into an oiled sheet pan, dimple with fingers, rest 2 hours.
Bake at 450°F for 22–25 minutes until deep golden.

title: Braised short rib
steps: Sear short ribs on all sides, set aside.
Sauté carrots, onion, and garlic until softened.
Deglaze with red wine, reduce by half.
Return ribs to the pot, add stock, cover and braise at 325°F for 3 hours.
